## How can I edit this code?

There are several ways of editing your application.

**Use Lovable**

Simply visit the [Lovable Project](https://lovable.dev/projects/5b434043-e133-4e30-ae8d-d421dd164043) and start prompting.

Changes made via Lovable will be committed automatically to this repo.

**Use your preferred IDE**

If you want to work locally using your own IDE, you can clone this repo and push changes. Pushed changes will also be reflected in Lovable.

The only requirement is having Node.js & npm installed - [install with nvm](https://github.com/nvm-sh/nvm#installing-and-updating)

Follow these steps:

```sh
# Step 1: Clone the repository using the project's Git URL.
git clone <YOUR_GIT_URL>

# Step 2: Navigate to the project directory.
cd <YOUR_PROJECT_NAME>

# Step 3: Install the necessary dependencies.
npm i

# Step 4: Start the development server with auto-reloading and an instant preview.
npm run dev
```

**Edit a file directly in GitHub**

- Navigate to the desired file(s).
- Click the "Edit" button (pencil icon) at the top right of the file view.
- Make your changes and commit the changes.

**Use GitHub Codespaces**

- Navigate to the main page of your repository.
- Click on the "Code" button (green button) near the top right.
- Select the "Codespaces" tab.
- Click on "New codespace" to launch a new Codespace environment.
- Edit files directly within the Codespace and commit and push your changes once you're done.

concept.name: Annual Story Weaver
concept.one_liner: A tool to help users craft and share their personal annual stories.
concept.core_promise: Create and share a compelling personal story by the end of the year to reflect on your journey and achievements.

buyers.pain: They struggle with summarizing and sharing their annual achievements and stories creatively.
candidate_phrases: how to write a year in review
creative ways to summarize a year
how to share my year story

judged.rationale: The idea taps into the niche practice of reflecting on and sharing one's year-in-review, common during year-end seasons. While there's moderate interest, urgency is low because it's not a constant need. MVP can be simple to test - a web tool to compile stories using templates. Distribution can be done through social media and SEO around year-end content. Retention is moderate since it might become a yearly habit for some users. Without any clear unique edge or existing audience mentioned, the advantage score remains low.

keyword_data.phrase: how to write a year in review
creative ways to summarize a year
how to share my year story

top_phrases.phrase: how to write a year in review
creative ways to summarize a year
how to share my year story

offers.anchor_phrase: how to write a year in review
offers.offer_copy: For individuals documenting their year-in-review who want to reflect meaningfully on their achievements but struggle to summarize creatively, we provide guided storytelling templates and prompts so they capture their personal journey without feeling overwhelmed.
offers.landing_page_headline: Simplify Your Year in Review with Guided Templates

offers_and_verdict.next_action: Conduct qualitative interviews with 5-10 potential users to deeply understand their pain points and willingness to pay for storytelling tools, and adjust the offering accordingly.
offers_and_verdict.reasoning: The search phrases indicate very low demand, with almost no interest or competition. The highest-interest term itself has a low interest score of 10/100, suggesting very limited search volume. This is a niche pain point with low buyer urgency and willingness to pay, and the advantage score indicates there's little to differentiate this idea in the market. The next sensible step for the founder is to gain qualitative insights to either pivot the offering to a stronger pain point or validate that the current pain is significant enough to pursue further.
